title: The Alley Stage

services.name: Other Showtimes
services.desc: Hailing from the legendary comedy stages of Chicago and Los Angeles, Ross Kimball and Rachel LaForce bring a masterclass in long-form improvisation to The Alley Stage. Having cut their teeth at iO Chicago and The Second City, this powerhouse duo combines world-class technical skill with the kind of unpredictable, high-energy chemistry that only comes from years of shared history in the trenches of the national comedy scene. Ross Kimball is a newly Atlanta-based actor, writer, and comedian best known for his breakout role as Ross Kubiak on the four-time Emmy-nominated series Jury Duty on Amazon.
